pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Wie geht's?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thank you
   B. good day (daytime greeting)
   C. sorry, excuse me
   D. How are you?

2. What does "Sehr gut" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. see you soon
   B. very good
   C. please
   D. yes

3. What does "die Uhr" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. table
   B. house
   C. clock
   D. cooker

4. What does "der Tag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. Saturday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Monday

5. What does "Welcher Tag ist heute?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. How old are you?
   B. What is the weather today?
   C. Which day is it today?
   D. Where is the school?

6. What number is "sechzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 16

7. In "Wir essen zusammen", what does zusammen mean? (1 mark)
   A. alone
   B. early
   C. together
   D. later

8. How is the letter Z named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ell
   B. ay
   C. tset
   D. gay

9. How is the letter U named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ess
   B. bay
   C. oo
   D. yot

10. What does "Wie heißt du?" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. see you soon
   B. please
   C. sorry, excuse me
   D. What is your name?

11. What does "Sie ist alt, aber sehr nett" mean? (1 mark)
   A. She is young and funny
   B. She is old but very kind
   C. She is tall and strong
   D. She is old and unkind

12. What does "die Tochter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sister
   B. father
   C. brother
   D. daughter

13. What does "dort" mean? (1 mark)
   A. always
   B. now
   C. there
   D. here

14. What does "der Tisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. door
   C. table
   D. cooker

15. What does "der Donnerstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Saturday
   C. weekend
   D. Monday

16. What does "Noch einmal!" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye!
   B. Well done!
   C. Thank you!
   D. One more time!

17. What does "Mai" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. May
   C. October
   D. August

18. What does "November" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. September
   C. November
   D. March

19. Which German word is the number 10? (1 mark)
   A. vier
   B. acht
   C. zehn
   D. dreizehn

20. Which food group does "der Kohl" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Obst

21. Which food group does "der Kakao" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Obst

22. What does "Zum Frühstück esse ich Brot" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sell bread
   B. I bake bread
   C. For lunch I eat bread
   D. For breakfast I eat bread

23. What does "der Fuß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. foot
   B. eye
   C. arm
   D. shoulder

24. What does "schlafen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to see
   B. to sleep
   C. to eat
   D. to speak

25. Which German word means "tall or big"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. jung
   B. lustig
   C. nett
   D. groß

26. What does "fleißig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. kind
   B. tall or big
   C. hard-working
   D. young

27. What is the plural of "die Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. die Schwester
   B. die Schwesters
   C. die Schwestern
   D. die Schwestere

28. What is the plural of "der Baum"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bäume
   B. die Baume
   C. die Baums
   D. die Bäumen

29. Which little word goes with the noun "Toilette"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

30. What is the plural of "der Tisch"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tischen
   B. die Tischs
   C. die Tischer
   D. die Tische

31. Which German word or phrase means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. der Donnerstag
   B. der Sonntag
   C. der Mittwoch
   D. der Tag

32. What does "Dezember" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. February
   C. August
   D. June

33. Which ordinal means "tenth"? (1 mark)
   A. der achte
   B. der zehnte
   C. der elfte
   D. der neunte

34. What does "August" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. July
   C. September
   D. June

35. Which little word goes with the noun "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

36. Which German word or phrase means "milk"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kartoffel
   B. der Apfel
   C. die Milch
   D. der Saft

37. Which is the correct spelling for fruit? (1 mark)
   A. Obts
   B. Obst
   C. Opst
   D. Öbst

38. Which German word means "cloudy"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. trocken
   C. wolkig
   D. windig

39. Which German word means "dry"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. wolkig
   B. heiß
   C. trocken
   D. warm

40. Which completes "Das Bild hängt an ___ Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. der
   C. dem
   D. das

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana. (3 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family. (3 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose. (5 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock. (2 marks)

46. Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday". (2 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder. (4 marks)

48. Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud. (3 marks)

49. Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home. (3 marks)

50. Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)." (3 marks)

51. Write three sentences about today's weather in German. (3 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

53. Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English. (3 marks)

54. Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink. (3 marks)

55. Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line. (3 marks)

56. Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday. (2 marks)

57. Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is. (2 marks)

58. Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana. (4 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork. (4 marks)

60. Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — How are you?
   Wie geht's? means How are you?.

2. B — very good
   Sehr gut means very good.

3. C — clock
   die Uhr means clock.

4. A — day
   der Tag means day.

5. C — Which day is it today?
   Welcher Tag means which day and heute means today.

6. D — 16
   sechzehn is the number 16.

7. C — together
   zusammen means together.

8. C — tset
   In German the letter Z is called tset.

9. C — oo
   In German the letter U is called oo.

10. D — What is your name?
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?.

11. B — She is old but very kind
   alt = old, aber = but, sehr nett = very kind.

12. D — daughter
   die Tochter means daughter.

13. C — there
   dort means there.

14. C — table
   der Tisch means table.

15. A — Thursday
   der Donnerstag means Thursday.

16. D — One more time!
   Noch einmal means once more.

17. B — May
   Mai means May.

18. C — November
   November means November.

19. C — zehn
   10 in German is zehn.

20. C — das Gemüse
   der Kohl belongs to das Gemüse.

21. B — die Getränke
   der Kakao belongs to die Getränke.

22. D — For breakfast I eat bread
   Frühstück is breakfast.

23. A — foot
   der Fuß means foot.

24. B — to sleep
   schlafen means to sleep.

25. D — groß
   tall or big in German is groß.

26. C — hard-working
   fleißig means hard-working.

27. C — die Schwestern
   The plural of die Schwester is die Schwestern.

28. A — die Bäume
   The plural of der Baum is die Bäume.

29. D — die
   It is die Toilette, so the little word is die.

30. D — die Tische
   The plural of der Tisch is die Tische.

31. D — der Tag
   day in German is der Tag.

32. A — December
   Dezember means December.

33. B — der zehnte
   zehn is ten, zehnte is tenth.

34. A — August
   August means August.

35. A — das
   It is das Wasser, so the little word is das.

36. C — die Milch
   milk in German is die Milch.

37. B — Obst
   The word is Obst.

38. C — wolkig
   cloudy in German is wolkig.

39. C — trocken
   dry in German is trocken.

40. B — der
   Wand is a die word, so an der Wand.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb form.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.
